scope: live tool turn through the plugin in an isolated dsh headless profile

setup.dsh_home: isolated temporary directory, not the user desktop profile
setup.plugin_install: local checkout link for the iteration; the GitHub spec install was measured separately in install-2026-11-11.json

proven: A live tool turn in an installed isolated dsh profile stores a complete native request record and sets retentionAudit accepted for every turn.
The recorded tool list holds the dsh MCP server tools and the CLI inert DeferredToolPlaceholder, whose full definition is recorded.
The advisor tool is absent from the recorded tool list.
not_proven: The literal issue acceptance item 'the recorded tool list contains only the dsh MCP server tools' is not met: the CLI inserts one inert placeholder. The design permits it only with its complete definition recorded.
Signed-thinking signature retention is not measured by this run; the model produced no thinking block in these turns.
An image-bearing request reports unavailable because the capture refuses image content.
No supported launch control removed the inert placeholder; ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=0 and CLAUDE_CODE_DROP_UNAVAILABLE_DEFERRED_TOOL=1 were tried and did not remove it.
